mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy eases.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines over 3 months, or Rank IC over 3-year windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 4.5% for two consecutive months signals labor market deterioration that reduces corporate profit growth expectations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 4.5%, or Rank IC over 3-year windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad-based demand contraction that triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as recession risks escalate.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC over 3-year windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes, declining industrial production (INDPRO) signals manufacturing slowdown that reduces corporate earnings visibility, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances during late-cycle expansions when INDPRO declines, or Rank IC over 3-year windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts (HOUST) over the prior 3 months indicate strengthening consumer demand that drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as business investment accelerates.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where HOUST rises over 3 months, or Rank IC over 3-year windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate exceeding 4.0% for two consecutive months signals restrictive monetary policy that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.0%, or Rank IC over 3-year windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) indicate labor market deterioration that triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as earnings growth faces headwinds.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises, or Rank IC over 3-year windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In monetary tightening cycles, CPIAUCSL exceeding 3.5% for three consecutive months signals persistent inflation that delays rate cuts, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances during monetary tightening cycles when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.5%, or Rank IC over 3-year windows remains below 0.03.
